name: Alphonse Legros

summary.text: Alphonse Legros was a French, later British, painter, etcher, sculptor, and medallist. He moved to London in 1863 and later was naturalized as British.

18683097: Cupid and Psyche is an 1867 history painting by the French-British artist Alphonse Legros. It depicts a scene from Greek Mythology and Ancient Roman literature based on the story of Cupid and Psyche.
119924133: The Tinker is an 1874 genre painting by the French artist Alphonse Legros. It depicts a tinker in the French countryside mending a cauldron with copper cooking pots lying nearby.
